tasks.title: B3 Qualification Closure and B4 Entry Freeze
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Run #618 protected-main 14/14 and PIQB_B3_QUALIFIED are frozen as the only B4 entry authority; B3 tasks are recorded COMPLETE without rewriting historical candidate evidence.

tasks.title: Unified Desktop and Service API Factory
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Desktop and Service profiles register one governed P1-P6 route graph from shared registration code while preserving profile-specific transport controls and existing compatibility surfaces.

tasks.title: Unified Principal Resolution and RBAC Boundary
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Service identity is resolved through one injected principal resolver, default-deny has no development fallback, actor identity cannot be client-spoofed, and M8/P6 authorization remains delegated to frozen domain role policies without transport privilege bypass.

tasks.title: Versioned Exact-ID Product API
tasks.minimum_acceptance: A versioned product API exposes exact immutable identifiers for admitted P1-P6 products without alias resolution, hidden recomputation, or mutable-latest semantics.

tasks.title: DTO OpenAPI and Client Contract Pipeline
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Unified API DTO/OpenAPI output is deterministic, frozen-authority traceable, profile-compatible, and sufficient for generated client contract verification without weakening the existing canonical DTO authority.

tasks.title: Persistent Audit Ledger
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Security-sensitive and mutation actions persist through existing DB 1.9 audit.audit_log with exact request/principal/object/reason provenance and SQLite/PostgreSQL restart parity; no shadow audit store is authoritative.

tasks.title: Structured Observability and Qualification State
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Health/readiness/version/product-qualification and structured operational records expose machine-readable fail-closed state without secrets, mutable aliases, or business-claim recomputation.

tasks.title: Unified API Security and Observability Qualification
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Desktop and Service unified surfaces pass exact route/DTO/security/RBAC/audit/observability/restart qualification on SQLite and real PostgreSQL under the unchanged exactly-14-job Hosted CI topology.
